title: fix(agent): treat missing x-ratelimit-remaining-* as unknown, not 100% exhausted
claim: A response carrying x-ratelimit-limit-<tag> without x-ratelimit-remaining-<tag> must parse as 'no data', not remaining=0 (100% exhausted), so /usage does not show false exhaustion and the Nous cross-session breaker cannot trip off a partial last-known state.

evidence.source: On main agent/rate_limit_tracker.py:96-104 builds every bucket with remaining=_safe_int(lowered.get('x-ratelimit-remaining-<tag>')) (default 0); nous_rate_guard._has_exhausted_bucket_in_object treats limit>0 & remaining<=0 & reset>=60 as exhausted; turn_recovery.py:1738 passes agent._rate_limit_state as last_known_state. nous_rate_guard._parse_buckets_from_headers already uses _safe_int(..., None) for the 429-header path (precedent). has_data consumers: gateway/slash_commands_status.py:206, hermes_cli/cli_info_mixin.py:724.
evidence.red: On main with only the new tests: test_rate_limit_tracker::test_missing_remaining_is_unknown_not_exhausted -> 'AssertionError: assert 100.0 == 0.0' (RateLimitBucket(limit=800, remaining=0, reset_seconds=30.0).usage_pct); test_nous_rate_guard::test_last_known_state_missing_remaining_stays_upstream -> 'AssertionError: assert True is False' (is_genuine_nous_rate_limit trips on limit+reset-only last-known state).
evidence.green: With fix: tests/agent/test_rate_limit_tracker.py + tests/agent/test_nous_rate_guard.py + tests/gateway/test_usage_command.py + tests/hermes_cli/test_cli_status_bar.py -> 59 passed, 0 failed.
evidence.negative_control: Reverting the None default for remaining (key line) -> both new tests fail again with the RED assertions. Reverting only the has_data change -> tracker test fails 'assert not True' (has_data). Both restored afterwards.
evidence.adjacent: tests/gateway/test_usage_command.py, tests/hermes_cli/test_cli_status_bar.py (59 incl. target files) and tests/agent/test_credits_cold_start.py, test_nous_welcome_client_contract.py, test_welcome_error_identity.py, test_welcome_tier_recovery.py (80) all pass; ruff clean.

upstream_overlap: #40460 OPEN (HeLLGURD) touches rate_limit_tracker.py: _fmt_count negative guard only - different defect
#128670 OPEN (jjunghwa0928) Anthropic unified headers in rate_limit_tracker.py - feature, does not change missing-remaining handling of x-ratelimit-*
#78167 OPEN (aroncomcap) proactive throttle on is_exhausted buckets - would amplify this bug (false-exhausted buckets throttle/record breaker); our fix makes it safer
#54507 CLOSED (briandevans) limit>0 in header-path exhausted check - related guard family, closed
No issue/PR owns missing-remaining->0; no origin_refs
notes: Rebuilt on current main (main refactored bucket construction into a _BUCKET_TAGS comprehension; fork diff did not apply verbatim). Kept the has_data tightening because without it the fixed limit-only case renders an empty gateway 'Rate Limits:' line; it is covered by the tracker test (negative control proves it). Dropped fork's 9 tests (TestPartialHeaders/TestHasData, several change-detector-ish) to 2 behaviour-contract tests. Kanban baggage excluded. Unparseable remaining is now also 'no data' (previously 0 = exhausted). NOT_TESTED: full suite; live provider responses.
